newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-JUVENTUS ARE BOOKMAKERS' EURO CUP FAVOURITES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS ARE BOOKMAKERS' EURO CUP FAVOURITES.

text.p: Juventus were installed as favourites to win the European Cup by two British bokmakers after the final Champions' League group matches were completed on Wednesday.
However, they were quoted at different odds.
Ladbrokes bookmakers made the Italian team 11-8 favourites while William Hill said they were 6-4.
Ladbrokes made Borussia Dortmund of Germany and Portugal's Porto joint second favourites at 9-2, with England's Manchester United down from 14-1 to 7-1.
William Hill had Manchester United as second favourites at 11-2, with Dutch side Ajax Amsterdan and Porto at 6-1.
